definitions.explanation: A person who creates visual art such as painting, sculpture, or other fine arts.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{美術家|びじゅつか}の{作品|さくひん}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I saw works by a famous artist.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{若|わか}くして{美術家|びじゅつか}として{認|みと}められた。
examples.english: She was recognized as an artist at a young age.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}には{多|おお}くの{美術家|びじゅつか}が{集|あつ}まり、{独自|どくじ}のアートシーンを{作|つく}り{上|あ}げている。
examples.english: Many artists gather in this town and have built a unique art scene.

notes:
Compound of {美術|びじゅつ} (fine art) + {家|か} (professional suffix). Refers specifically to practitioners of visual or fine arts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現代|げんだい}{美術家|びじゅつか}: contemporary artist
- {美術家|びじゅつか}として{活動|かつどう}する: to work as an artist
- {美術家|びじゅつか}{団体|だんたい}: artists' association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {芸術家|げいじゅつか}: artist (broader) — covers all arts including music, literature, and performance
- {画家|がか}: painter — specifically someone who paints
- アーティスト: artist (loanword) — broader and more casual; often used for musicians and performers too
